lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review future plans, suggestions, and real conditions in one social planning dialogue.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues make a realistic weekend or after-work plan with one possible complication.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a weekend café, walk, or movie plan and adjust it depending on time or weather.

main_focus.name: week 3 planning review
main_focus.description: Combine ska, kommer att, Ska vi, and one om-condition without overloading the dialogue.
model_examples: Ska vi ta en fika på lördag?
Om det regnar, kan vi gå på bio.
Det kommer att bli kallt på kvällen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 ska forms, 1-2 kommer att predictions, and 1-2 om-conditions naturally.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Reuse week 3 planning chunks in a compact, believable conversation.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker proposes a weekend or after-work plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention a likely condition or forecast and compare two options.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a flexible decision.

target_complexity.repetition: review week 3 future and condition patterns in a balanced way

focus: the condition or forecast that may change the plan
the flexible decision at the end

sentence_focus: one suggestion starting with Ska vi
one sentence with ska for a plan
one sentence with kommer att for a prediction
one sentence with om and weather
one sentence confirming a flexible decision
